faq.title: We answer your
faq.subtitle: The most common questions before starting a project.
faq.ctaSubtitle: Write to us directly and we'll respond within 24 hours.

items.q: How long does it take to develop a project?
items.a: It depends on complexity. An optimized website takes 1-2 weeks. Complex web applications or AI integrations can take 4-8 weeks. In the initial consultation we give you an exact timeline with clear milestones.

items.q: What is the cost of your services?
items.a: Projects range from $500 USD for websites to $5,000+ USD for enterprise applications. We offer flexible payment plans (50% upfront, 50% on delivery) and personalized quotes.

items.q: Do you offer maintenance after launch?
items.a: Yes. We include 30 days of free technical support post-launch. Afterwards we offer monthly maintenance plans from $100 USD with updates, backups and priority support.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Mexico?
items.a: Absolutely. We work with clients throughout Latin America and the United States. All communication is remote using modern collaborative tools.
React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Firebase, MySQL, MongoDB, WordPress and Google Gemini for AI. We select the optimal stack for each specific project.

items.q: What if I'm not satisfied with the result?
items.a: We work with unlimited revisions during development until you are 100% satisfied. If we don't meet what was agreed, we offer a proportional refund guarantee.

items.q: How does the payment process work?
items.a: 50% at the start of the project to reserve the schedule and begin development. The remaining 50% is paid upon approved final delivery. We accept bank transfer and PayPal.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Text: NEXORATECH Solutions, based in Tehuacán, Puebla, Mexico, is the data controller for the personal data you provide through this website.
privacy.s2Text: Through the contact form we only collect:
s2Items: Project type or service of interest
privacy.s2Note: We do not collect sensitive, financial or minors' data.
privacy.s3Text: The collected data is used exclusively for:
s3Items: Responding to your inquiries and service requests
Sending information related to the requested services
Managing the commercial relationship between the parties
privacy.s4Text: Your personal data from the contact form will not be sold, transferred or shared with third parties, except by legal obligation or when strictly necessary to provide the contracted service (for example, email sending platforms such as Nodemailer/SMTP). Browsing data collected by Google Analytics and Google AdSense is processed by Google LLC in accordance with their privacy policy. We do not share personal data from the contact form with these analytics or advertising services.
privacy.s5Text: Data will be retained for the time necessary to address your request and, subsequently, for the legally required period or until you request its deletion.
privacy.s6Text: In accordance with the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (Mexico), you have the right to:
s6Items: Access — know what data we have about you
Cancellation — request the deletion of your data
Opposition — oppose the processing of your data
privacy.s6Note: To exercise these rights, contact us through the site's contact form.
privacy.s7Text: This website uses Google Analytics 4 to analyze traffic and improve user experience, and Google AdSense to display relevant ads. Both services use cookies and similar technologies to collect browsing data (pages visited, time on site, approximate location, device used). This data is processed in aggregate form and does not personally identify you. Additionally, we use the browser's localStorage to save accessibility preferences and dark mode locally on your device. Please refer to our Cookie Policy for more details.
privacy.s8Text: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or alteration.
privacy.s9Text: We reserve the right to update this policy. Any changes will be published on this same page with the corresponding update date.
privacy.s10Text: For any questions related to this policy, you can contact us through the form available on the main page or via LinkedIn.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.s1Text: Cookies are small text files that websites store on your device to remember information about your visit. There are different types: essential cookies, analytics cookies, advertising cookies, among others.
cookies.s2Text: Yes. This website uses third-party cookies through Google Analytics 4 (web analytics) and Google AdSense (advertising). These cookies allow us to understand how users interact with our site and display relevant ads to fund the free content we offer.
cookies.s3Text: The cookies present on this site are classified as:
s3Items: Analytics cookies (Google Analytics 4): Collect anonymous data about pages visited, time spent, traffic source, and device used. They help us improve the site.
Advertising cookies (Google AdSense): Allow displaying personalized ads based on your browsing interests. Google may use this information according to their own privacy policy.
Local storage (localStorage): We save dark/light mode, accessibility, and language preferences. This data is NOT cookies and remains only on your device.
cookies.s3Note: Google Analytics and AdSense cookies are managed by Google LLC. You can review Google's privacy policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy
cookies.s4Text: You can configure your browser to reject cookies or delete existing ones at any time. Please note that blocking cookies may affect the functionality of some site elements (such as ads). You can also opt out of Google ad personalization by visiting https://adssettings.google.com
cookies.s5Text: This site is hosted on Netlify and uses Google services (Analytics and AdSense). Each provider has their own privacy policy: Netlify (https://www.netlify.com/privacy), Google (https://policies.google.com/privacy).
cookies.s6Text: If we incorporate new cookies or tracking tools, we will update this policy and inform users. For any questions, contact us through the contact form on the main page.
